messages.subject: pushed bracket changes
parts:
I did the global search and replace on both the
doc and all the models. The unit tests now all work
again. I skimmed an output report and did some other
investigations and I think the models should now all be
OK, too.

The new syntax for dimension declarations, interval
constraints, and truncated probability functions is as
follows:


real a[3,4,5];

vector[4] b;

matrix[4,5] c;

real[-1,1] rho;

vector[4] d[3,2];

a ~ normal(0,1) T[0,];

I didn't check the Java program in, but I have it in
case anyone else needs it for something.

- Bob

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] pushed bracket changes
parts:
B
As I sent in my last email msg to the group, I'm not so thrilled with notation such as real, vector, matrix (I assume we're using "array" for arrays of more than 2 dimension?). I'd prefer if we could just use "real" for real, "integer" for integer, etc. Perhaps we can discuss, this isn't something that is necessary perhaps, I'd be interested in hearing the rationale for doing it the way you're doing it now.
A
